limitations: Retrospective 20-patient case series; only Table 1 rows, the Table 1 footnote, case-numbered sentences and the three figure captions are assigned to individual patients. Cohort counts (symptoms, misdiagnosis, complications, CT/ultrasound counts, anti-reflux treatment in fourteen patients, recurrence statements) are not copied to individuals.
Figure captions refer to the 19th and 3rd child "in table 2" but the article contains only Table 1; ordinals are matched to Table 1 rows 19 and 3.
The Table 1 treatment cell "4–2" for patients 8 and 12 is decoded as cyst aspiration and plasma cyst ablation via the footnote; the cell does not state their order.
The "surgery" in the case 9 and case 3 post-surgery sentences is not named in those sentences and is not linked to a specific table treatment.
No patient ages, presenting symptoms, imaging or laboratory values are given per patient apart from the case-numbered text and figure captions.
Caption-layer figure visual status is not_inspected; actual pixels were inspected in visual.json.

History of intubation N cells (patients 6 to 20) are recorded as assertion=absent: under the Y/N column header the cell is the table's explicit negation; the EVID-NEGATION warnings on these items are checker false positives.
Figure 1-3 captions cite "table 2"; Figure 3 (3rd child) is corroborated by the case 3 text that cites Figure 3, which confirms the captions use Table 1 numbering, so Figures 1-2 are kept on row 19.

limitations: Retrospective 20-patient case series; only Table 1 rows, the Table 1 footnote, case-numbered sentences and the three figure captions are assigned to individual patients. Cohort counts (symptoms, misdiagnosis, complications, CT/ultrasound counts, anti-reflux treatment in fourteen patients, recurrence statements) are not copied to individuals.
Figure captions refer to the 19th and 3rd child "in table 2" but the article contains only Table 1; ordinals are matched to Table 1 rows 19 and 3.
The Table 1 treatment cell "4–2" for patients 8 and 12 is decoded as cyst aspiration and plasma cyst ablation via the footnote; the cell does not state their order.
The "surgery" in the case 9 and case 3 post-surgery sentences is not named in those sentences and is not linked to a specific table treatment.
No patient ages, presenting symptoms, imaging or laboratory values are given per patient apart from the case-numbered text and figure captions.
Caption-layer figure visual status is not_inspected; actual pixels were inspected in visual.json.

History of intubation N cells (patients 6 to 20) are recorded as assertion=absent: under the Y/N column header the cell is the table's explicit negation; the EVID-NEGATION warnings on these items are checker false positives.
Figure 1-3 captions cite "table 2"; Figure 3 (3rd child) is corroborated by the case 3 text that cites Figure 3, which confirms the captions use Table 1 numbering, so Figures 1-2 are kept on row 19.
